description: Valerie shares refreshing frozen fruit ideas. Dr. Hanna explains why women crave sugar at night. Deidre has tips for mascara on lash extensions and Denise reveals buyer turn-offs. And Valerie styles floral fashion for non-floral fans.

title: Showcase Hawaii
description: Experience the Palua Paua Shell Koa Bracelet, crafted from paua shell and genuine koa wood.

title: The Champ Show
description: Join Champ as he visits local establishments and shows you the products and services they offer, including tasting the cuisine of Hawaii's eateries.

title: Ninth Island Connection
description: Join Host Sebastian Rodriguez as he explores the dining, entertainment, events and amenities of the locals' favorite, South Point Casino.

title: Cookin' With Cutty
description: Cutty and gardening students explore Waimea's Hawaii Farming, learning to grow Keiki Greens. They craft pizzas and homemade sauce with Chef Jay, and meet innovators creating 3D-printed stethoscopes for global communities in need.

title: Painting in Paradise
description: After meeting some deep-sea marine animals on the Okeanos Expolorer, Patrick will show you how to draw the strange-looking Sea Robin. Join a deep-sea animal painting event at the Mokupapapa Discovery Center in Hilo.
